critique: The black field, mint-white line strings, dotted particle trails, and animated deformation remain consistent with the Horns (Lines) look. Across t1 to t4, however, the form is still far too large for the frame: several bundles enter and exit through every edge, while the central crossing is a congested bright knot. The paired horn silhouette cannot be read as a complete, intentional structure, and the dense overlap obscures the individual line detail.

suggestions.why: Reduce the base shape X extent so the horn bundles and their tapered ends can remain visible inside the composition rather than being clipped at the left and right edges.
Reduce the Z extent with X to pull the projected ribbons back into a more legible paired-horns composition rather than oversized frame-spanning arcs.
Lower string density to separate the line strands at the central overlap and prevent the intersections from blooming into broad white bands.
